_comment: Setup + PID configuration reference for this capture, added retrospectively (2026-06-26) for future reference. The captured .bin is the v3 (wc-capped) run; the analysis compares it against the prior v1/v2 runs as a gain sweep (gain_sweep_context below). Pitch gains verbatim from README.md and pitch_tune.json; roll/yaw are the concurrently-active rig tune (not the focus).
capture_type: armed verification hover after the wc-capped pitch tune v3 (concludes the pitch fault is physical, not tuning)

hardware.airframe: X-quad. M1,M3 CW / M2,M4 CCW. IMU aligned. A motor was already burned out earlier this session; pitch axis suspected physically asymmetric.

motor_geometry._comment: Inverted spin vs firmware default (flips s_mix_yaw only). Roll/pitch mix unchanged. REQUIRED.

firmware.rate_controller_algo: PID cascade (RATE_CTRL_PID). INDI (firmware/src/control/rate_indi.c) did not exist until 2026-06-26 — it was NOT running here.
firmware.tune_applied: pitch tune v3 (tools/sysid/pitch_tune.json) over the rig tune for roll/yaw; re-applied each boot via tools/sysid/apply_tune.py
firmware.note: FC does not persist tunes across power cycles.

pid._units: rate: controller=1; angle: controller=0, kp in (deg/s)/deg. These are the gains ACTIVE for the captured pitch-verify.bin (v3).

roll.status: sysid-tuned roll (rock-stable this run; the control)

pitch.status: sysid wc-capped v3 (pitch inner loop matched to roll's 1.1 Hz crossover)
sysid wc-capped v3 (0.25*wc with wc=7.0; matches roll's proven 1.69)

gain_sweep_context._comment: Three pitch gain sets compared across the 2026-06-25 pitch sessions. Gain-invariant limit cycle + worsening saturation => authority-limited, NOT a linear-gain problem.

identified_plant._comment: Pitch K is 2.45x roll's on a symmetric X-quad — a red flag the pitch axis was already asymmetric when identified.

pitch.note: suspect — fit on an asymmetric axis

physical_evidence._comment: Motor command means this run (X-quad, 0-indexed; pitch = front M0,M3 vs back M1,M2).
physical_evidence.interpretation: front pair ~20 % harder than back (left/right balanced) -> pitch imbalance; craft trims nose-up (pitch mean -13 deg); loop runs out of authority on one side and bang-bangs.

headline: NOT a tuning problem. Across 3 gain sets (rate_kp 0.005-0.012, angle_kp 1.75-4.14) pitch limit-cycles at 1.5-2.6 Hz while roll is rock-stable, and pitch_out saturates 19->37 % (gain-invariant => authority-limited). Likely physical pitch-axis fault (CG forward / degraded back motor-ESC / prop). Stop tuning gains; fix the hardware, then re-sysid. Safe parking config: revert pitch to firmware-default soft pure-P seed (rate_kp 0.0005, ki 0).
